'''Jaliq Ramas''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Ramas compiled a report on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Selnesh/Legends|Selnesh]] and its [[Selnesh Imperial Detention Center|detention center]] for [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].
